learningObjectives: Identify the stages of an end-to-end data pipeline.
Differentiate extraction, transformation, and loading operations.
Design a basic pipeline for preparing data for analysis or machine learning.

activities.title: Pipeline Overview
activities.instruction: Explore the major stages through which data moves from source to destination.

content.concept: A data pipeline moves data from sources through ingestion and transformation to storage and downstream consumption.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Provides raw data such as databases, files, APIs, or sensors.
Collects or transfers data into the pipeline.
Cleans, validates, joins, aggregates, or reshapes the data.
Stores processed data for later use.
Consumes prepared data for reporting, analysis, or machine learning.

activities.title: ETL Anatomy
activities.instruction: Identify what happens during extraction, transformation, and loading.

content.concept: ETL extracts data from source systems, transforms it into a useful format, and loads it into a target destination.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Retrieve data from one or more source systems.
Clean, validate, combine, or reshape the extracted data.
Write the transformed data to its destination.
The original location from which data is collected.
The database, warehouse, lake, or other destination receiving the data.

activities.title: Build the Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the components needed for a basic data preparation pipeline.

content.concept: A reliable pipeline connects ingestion, validation, transformation, storage, and downstream consumption.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: ETL Sequence
activities.instruction: Order the core ETL operations correctly.

content.concept: The ETL process follows a logical flow from extracting source data through transformation to loading the processed result.
